tools.name: getresponse_get_account
tools.description: Get the authenticated GetResponse account profile (id, email, name, company, plan, timezone, etc.). REST: GET /accounts.

tools.name: getresponse_list_campaigns
tools.description: List the account's campaigns — GetResponse's name for mailing lists a contact can subscribe to. Paginated. Optional name filter and sort. REST: GET /campaigns.

tools.name: getresponse_get_campaign
tools.description: Get a single campaign (mailing list) by id, including subscription confirmation settings. REST: GET /campaigns/{campaignId}.

tools.name: getresponse_list_contacts
tools.description: List/search contacts across the account. Paginated, with optional email/name/campaign filters, sort, and a fields selector. REST: GET /contacts.

tools.name: getresponse_get_contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by id, including campaign membership, tags, custom field values and engagement scoring. REST: GET /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: getresponse_list_newsletters
tools.description: List newsletters (one-off email broadcasts). Paginated, with optional subject filter and sort. REST: GET /newsletters.

tools.name: getresponse_get_newsletter
tools.description: Get a single newsletter (email broadcast) by id, including its status and send settings. REST: GET /newsletters/{newsletterId}.

tools.name: getresponse_list_autoresponders
tools.description: List autoresponders (drip/cycle emails sent automatically on a schedule after subscription). Paginated. REST: GET /autoresponders.

tools.name: getresponse_list_tags
tools.description: List the account's tags (labels applied to contacts for segmentation). REST: GET /tags.

tools.name: getresponse_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the account's custom field definitions (custom contact attributes) — id, name, type and values. REST: GET /custom-fields.

tools.name: getresponse_list_from_fields
tools.description: List the account's verified 'from' fields (sender name/email addresses usable when sending). REST: GET /from-fields.

tools.name: getresponse_create_contact
tools.description: Add a contact to a campaign (mailing list). GetResponse processes this asynchronously and returns HTTP 202 (queued) with no body — the contact appears in the list within a few minutes. REST: POST /contacts.

tools.name: getresponse_update_contact
tools.description: Update an existing contact's mutable fields (name, tags, custom field values). Only the fields you supply are changed. REST: POST /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: getresponse_delete_contact
tools.description: Delete (remove) a contact from the account. This unsubscribes them and deletes their data. REST: DELETE /contacts/{contactId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: getresponse_get_account, getresponse_list_contacts, getresponse_list_newsletters, getresponse_get_newsletter, getresponse_list_autoresponders, getresponse_list_from_fields, getresponse_create_contact · Private data: getresponse_list_campaigns, getresponse_list_contacts, getresponse_get_contact, getresponse_list_tags, getresponse_list_custom_fields, getresponse_create_contact, getresponse_update_contact, getresponse_delete_contact · Public sink: getresponse_get_account, getresponse_list_contacts, getresponse_list_newsletters, getresponse_get_newsletter, getresponse_list_from_fields, getresponse_create_contact, getresponse_update_contact · Destructive: getresponse_delete_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: getresponse_get_account, getresponse_list_contacts, getresponse_list_newsletters, getresponse_get_newsletter, getresponse_list_autoresponders, getresponse_list_from_fields, getresponse_create_contact · Private data: getresponse_list_campaigns, getresponse_list_contacts, getresponse_get_contact, getresponse_list_tags, getresponse_list_custom_fields, getresponse_create_contact, getresponse_update_contact, getresponse_delete_contact · Public sink: getresponse_get_account, getresponse_list_contacts, getresponse_list_newsletters, getresponse_get_newsletter, getresponse_list_from_fields, getresponse_create_contact, getresponse_update_contact · Destructive: getresponse_delete_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
